title: The scheduler's replay holds what its writer holds, and the second reader restates it
note: AUD-068 to AUD-071. What enqueue() refuses is refused on replay -- a need that is not a whole, non-negative number of a named resource, a citation that is not a digest, an id that is not a str (SK1 to SK6); one grant of possession, a dispatch's lease or one renewal, reaches at most MAX_LEASE_SEQS (SK7 to SK10); a priority is an int as set_priority writes it (SK11); a malformed record is refused in the reducer's words, at its position (SK12 to SK18); the second reader restates the enqueue, lease and priority rules (SK19 to SK26); an enqueue names no lease end, and writes its lists and its map in the writer's form (SK27 to SK30); the second reader restates the enqueue's lease end and what a job waits on (SK31 to SK36). tests/test_scheduler_replay_rules.py holds each.
